accrual(bytes6).details: Retrieve the rate accrual since maturity, maturing if necessary.

balances(bytes12).details: Each vault records debt and collateral balances_.

build(address,bytes12,bytes6,bytes6).details: Create a new vault, linked to a series (and therefore underlying) and up to 5 collateral types

debt(bytes6,bytes6).details: Max, min and sum of debt per underlying and collateral.

debtFromBase(bytes6,uint128).details: Convert a debt amount for a series from base to fyToken terms.

debtToBase(bytes6,uint128).details: Convert a debt amount for a series from fyToken to base terms

destroy(bytes12).details: Destroy an empty vault. Used to recover gas costs.

give(bytes12,address).details: Give a vault to another user.

lendingOracles(bytes6).details: Variable rate lending oracle for an underlying

level(bytes12).details: Return the collateralization level of a vault. It will be negative if undercollateralized.

mature(bytes6).details: Record the borrowing rate at maturity for a series

pour(bytes12,int128,int128).details: Manipulate a vault debt and collateral.

roll(bytes12,bytes6,int128).details: Change series and debt of a vault. The module calling this function also needs to buy underlying in the pool for the new series, and sell it in pool for the old series.

slurp(bytes12,uint128,uint128).details: Reduce debt and collateral from a vault, ignoring collateralization checks.

stir(bytes12,bytes12,uint128,uint128).details: Move collateral and debt between vaults.

tweak(bytes12,bytes6,bytes6).details: Change a vault series and/or collateral types.

vaults(bytes12).details: An user can own one or more Vaults, with each vault being able to borrow from a single series.

debtFromBase(bytes6,uint128).notice: Think about rounding if using, since we are dividing.
